question: What business meanings and relationships make Registry Context work?
answer: A named Context is registered with allowed exact selections; a consumer sends a Request; the capability verifies integrity and returns an immutable View or blocks.
outcomes: Context remains distinct from Request and View
only registered selections can enter a View
Context and selection drift fail closed
source and owner authority stay outside the resolver
claim_ceiling: Candidate business ontology and one prototype mapping only; no canonical specialization, DomainSpec release admission, adoption, or production conformance.
